name: linkedin-strategy-kit
description: Two-skill LinkedIn foundation kit. strategy: build a machine-readable LinkedIn social selling strategy in Notion — goals/KPI, ICP+persona, enemy+signature, content pillars, offer audit, voice profile, viral levers, distribution playbook. profile-audit: audit a LinkedIn profile against the 2026 optimization framework and that strategy, returning per-section rewrites (headline, About, banner brief, Featured plan) as a Topic Authority ranking signal. The setup layer of a LinkedIn content system.
